name: ruling-21-if-in-no-case-counts-in-a-block-not-read
reference: spec 0.20 ruling 21: an `if` naming a presence counts only when the innermost case it sits in is read; p.3 is named by an `if` in no case, inside the last opt, whose bit is 0: it counts as before (ruling 17 of 0.8), so the message is not malformed. Re-encode: w absent, p.3 is 0
